whenToUse: You explain increases and decreases step by step, such as from revenue to net profit.
You look at amounts coming in and going out, such as stock or headcount.
You find what changed the result the most.
whenNotToUse: The items have no order or cumulative relation (use a bar chart).
Changes in the value itself over time (use a line chart).
There are more than ten steps.

alternatives.name: Bar Chart
alternatives.reason: Only comparing the size of each item.

alternatives.name: Funnel Analysis
alternatives.reason: Seeing the number of people shrink at each step.

accessibility: Increases and decreases are written with + and − signs along with color.
Each bar has its value in text, and pointing at it reads the running total.
The table view lists the change and the running total together.
